description: Use when a text should not read as machine-written: rewrite it, audit it without rewriting, or build a reusable system prompt. Targets delve, seamless, robust, not-just-X-but-Y, em-dash abuse, chatbot leftovers, uniform paragraphs. Eleven non-fiction genres; intensity follows the genre. Not for fiction — a story's tells are structural. Triggers: «убери признаки AI», «сделай текст человечнее», «проверь на AI-обороты», "humanize this", "reads like ChatGPT", "de-slop", "unslop", "sounds like a model".

results.query: here are three samples of how I write. rewrite this draft in my voice and drop the machine phrasing
de-slop this blog post before I publish it
перепиши этот пост так, чтобы не было видно, что писала нейросеть
audit this article for AI markers — just tell me what's wrong, don't rewrite it yet
rewrite ~/drafts/announce.md so it doesn't read as machine-written, it's a crypto launch post
strip the em dashes and the 'it's important to note' stuff out of this draft
make slides out of this outline
formalize this task spec — it reads like an essay, too many evaluative words
my short story got flagged as AI-generated. the plot is too tidy and every emotion is a tightening chest. fix the narrative
